description: Wisconsin WIC provides food, nutrition education and breastfeeding support. Start a pre-application or contact the local WIC office, then complete its eligibility screening.
introduction: Wisconsin WIC provides food, nutrition education and breastfeeding support. Start a pre-application or contact the local WIC office, then complete its eligibility screening.

who: Wisconsin residents who are pregnant, recently postpartum, breastfeeding an eligible baby, or children under five.
Household income and nutrition needs are assessed by the clinic; foster parents and relatives can apply for a child in their care.
sections.get: Nutrition services and eWIC food benefits after approval. Ask the clinic about the foods suitable for each participant and how to use the card.
sections.docs: Prepare ID for each participant, Wisconsin address proof and household income records. The state accepts recent pay records or relevant program letters. Ask the clinic for a Family Portal link if sending proof online.
sections.apply:
1. Use Start your pre-application on the WIC homepage or contact your county or Tribal WIC office.
  2. Arrange screening and confirm attendance and records needed.
  3. Provide the requested information and complete health and nutrition questions.
sections.after: Approved participants receive an eWIC card. Keep clinic appointments and track benefit expiration; food benefits expire every 30 days. Use Wisconsin MyWIC or the card’s published contact route to check available foods.
